procedure.review_scope: Contact block; general scheduling, appearance, conferral, proposed-order and hearing-material sections. Motion-specific, foreclosure and detailed trial instructions not substantively analyzed.

checklist.summary: Coordinate with parties before using OnceHub for hearings of one hour or less. Longer settings require assistant confirmation; notices use Central Time and a courtesy notice is required for final calendar confirmation.

citation.quote: Hearing times must be scheduled via OnceHub.
citation.locator: Scheduling civil hearings / Notice of Hearing

checklist.summary: Evidentiary hearings and hearings longer than one hour require in-person appearance. OnceHub defaults to Zoom; email the assistant to convert an in-person setting.

citation.quote: Evidentiary hearings, regardless of amount of time, will require IN-PERSON appearance.

checklist.summary: The profile describes a substantive in-person or telephone conference and certification before motions, with listed exceptions. Consult the source for scope rather than treating email attempts as a conference.

citation.quote: a substantive conversation either in person or by telephone

checklist.summary: Use the portal proposed-order route, selecting Duncan; submit Word orders with the displayed signature/service language. A cover letter is not generally required.

citation.quote: Proposed orders are to be submitted in Word format.

checklist.summary: Use the portal hearing-materials option labeled for Judge Duncan; title submissions by hearing date and party. Do not send courtesy copies of material already filed.

citation.quote: Please DO NOT submit courtesy copies of anything that has already been filed in the case.
